@graph.name: Entry 26: pre-registered — the direction ladder on real ride endpoints, and portals (bridges/tunnels) in both the track and the search
@graph.text: The grid-connectivity bias survives the move from synthetic rings to real ride endpoints: under the app's default physics the 8-direction optimum sits 11.90% above the sq128 near-continuum reference (5.99/2.38/0.73% at 16/32/64), monotone on 86/86 pairs, with no lattice direction signature once corpus imbalance is removed (12.35 pp spread → 3.35 pp). But sq16 recovers only 49.69% of the gap [CI 45.9, 53.8], so the pre-registered ≥50% decision rule FAILS by 0.31 pp — while its CI straddles the threshold and the per-pair estimator reads 51.57%, which would pass.
